about.title: A platform built for Belgium, ready for Europe
about.p1: KREDIT blends Belgian banking rigour with fintech PWA fluidity. Every rule (rate, cap, scoring) is configurable per country and legally traceable.
about.p2: The final decision is always human. The engine recommends, the ADMIN decides, the SUPER_ADMIN validates exceptions beyond thresholds.
